quotes.text: At the monetary policy assessment of 9 and 10 December 2025, the Governing Board of the Swiss National Bank decided to leave the SNB policy rate unchanged at 0%.
The markets expected the SNB to leave its policy rate unchanged at the monetary policy assessment in December.
Taking into account all available indicators, the effect of monetary policy is expansionary.
The SNB expects GDP growth of just under 1.5% for 2025 and around 1% for 2026.
The Governing Board therefore decided to leave the SNB policy rate unchanged at 0%.

fragments.text: Contrary to expectations, inflation declined somewhat in recent months and stood at 0.0% in November.
Core inflation also declined somewhat, pointing to a slowdown in the underlying inflation dynamics.
